definition: the temperature and conditions such as sun, rain and wind
exampleSentence: What's the weather like today?
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay thời tiết thế nào?

definition: a statement about what the weather is likely to be
exampleSentence: The forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
exampleTranslation: Dự báo nói ngày mai trời sẽ mưa.

definition: a measure of how hot or cold a place is
exampleSentence: The temperature is 30 degrees today.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay nhiệt độ là 30 độ.

definition: one of the four periods of the year, such as spring
exampleSentence: My favourite season is summer.
exampleTranslation: Mùa tôi thích nhất là mùa hè.

definition: the season between winter and summer when flowers appear
exampleSentence: Flowers bloom in spring.
exampleTranslation: Hoa nở vào mùa xuân.

definition: the hottest season of the year, between spring and autumn
exampleSentence: We go to the beach every summer.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi biển mỗi mùa hè.

definition: the season between summer and winter when leaves change colour
exampleSentence: The leaves fall in autumn.
exampleTranslation: Lá rơi vào mùa thu.

definition: the coldest season of the year, after autumn
exampleSentence: It is very cold here in winter.
exampleTranslation: Ở đây mùa đông rất lạnh.

definition: the heat and light that come from the sun
exampleSentence: Too much sun is bad for you.
exampleTranslation: Phơi nắng quá nhiều không tốt cho bạn.

definition: the light and heat from the sun when there is no cloud
exampleSentence: We had three days of sunshine.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi có ba ngày nắng đẹp.

definition: with a lot of light from the sun
exampleSentence: It is a warm sunny day.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay là một ngày nắng ấm.

definition: having a high temperature
exampleSentence: It is very hot today.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay trời rất nóng.

definition: slightly hot in a pleasant way
exampleSentence: The house is warm.
exampleTranslation: Ngôi nhà rất ấm.

definition: low in temperature but not cold, in a pleasant way
exampleSentence: The water is nice and cool.
exampleTranslation: Nước mát rất dễ chịu.

definition: having a low temperature
exampleSentence: It was so cold this morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nay trời lạnh quá.

definition: extremely cold
exampleSentence: It is freezing in this room.
exampleTranslation: Trong phòng này lạnh cóng.

definition: with a lot of water in the air, so you feel hot and sticky
exampleSentence: It is very humid in summer.
exampleTranslation: Mùa hè ở đây rất oi bức.

definition: having very little rain or water
exampleSentence: The weather was hot and dry.
exampleTranslation: Thời tiết nóng và khô.

definition: covered in water, or rainy
exampleSentence: My shirt is still wet.
exampleTranslation: Áo của tôi vẫn còn ướt.

definition: a long period of very hot weather
exampleSentence: The heat wave lasted a week.
exampleTranslation: Đợt nắng nóng kéo dài một tuần.

definition: a long period of dry weather with not enough water
exampleSentence: The drought killed many crops.
exampleTranslation: Hạn hán làm chết nhiều cây trồng.

definition: a white or grey mass in the sky
exampleSentence: Dark clouds covered the sky.
exampleTranslation: Mây đen phủ kín bầu trời.

definition: with a lot of clouds in the sky
exampleSentence: It is cloudy this morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nay trời nhiều mây.

definition: water that falls from clouds in small drops
exampleSentence: The rain became heavier.
exampleTranslation: Mưa càng lúc càng nặng hạt.

definition: with a lot of rain
exampleSentence: It was a cold rainy day.
exampleTranslation: Đó là một ngày mưa lạnh.

definition: light rain with very small drops
exampleSentence: A light drizzle started when we left.
exampleTranslation: Mưa phùn bắt đầu khi chúng tôi ra về.

definition: a small pool of rainwater on the ground
exampleSentence: The children splashed in the puddles.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ nghịch nước trong các vũng nước.

definition: a curve of different colours in the sky when sun and rain meet
exampleSentence: Look at that beautiful rainbow!
exampleTranslation: Nhìn cầu vồng đẹp kìa!

definition: air that moves strongly or quickly
exampleSentence: The wind blew from the north.
exampleTranslation: Gió thổi từ phía bắc.

definition: with a lot of wind
exampleSentence: It is too windy for a picnic.
exampleTranslation: Trời nhiều gió quá nên không đi dã ngoại được.

definition: a gentle wind
exampleSentence: A cool breeze came off the sea.
exampleTranslation: Một làn gió mát thổi từ biển vào.

definition: thick cloudy air near the ground that is hard to see through
exampleSentence: We got lost in the thick fog.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi bị lạc trong sương mù dày.

definition: with a lot of fog
exampleSentence: It was a foggy morning.
exampleTranslation: Đó là một buổi sáng nhiều sương mù.

definition: a light cloud low over the ground
exampleSentence: We saw the hills through the mist.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi thấy những ngọn đồi qua màn sương.

definition: very bad weather with strong wind and heavy rain
exampleSentence: A big storm hit the town last night.
exampleTranslation: Một cơn bão lớn đã đổ vào thị trấn đêm qua.

definition: with strong winds, heavy rain and dark clouds
exampleSentence: The sky looks stormy.
exampleTranslation: Bầu trời trông như sắp có bão.

definition: the loud noise you hear during a storm
exampleSentence: The thunder woke us up in the night.
exampleTranslation: Tiếng sấm đánh thức chúng tôi trong đêm.

definition: a bright flash of light in the sky during a storm
exampleSentence: The tree was hit by lightning.
exampleTranslation: Cái cây bị sét đánh.

definition: a storm with thunder and lightning
translation: cơn giông, bão có sấm sét
exampleSentence: There was a thunderstorm last night.
exampleTranslation: Đêm qua có giông kèm sấm sét.

definition: a very strong tropical storm
exampleSentence: The typhoon hit the coast on Friday.
exampleTranslation: Bão đổ bộ vào bờ biển hôm thứ Sáu.

definition: a storm with very strong winds that forms over the sea
exampleSentence: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
exampleTranslation: Cơn bão đã phá hủy nhiều ngôi nhà.

definition: a large amount of water covering land that is usually dry
exampleSentence: The village was cut off by floods.
exampleTranslation: Ngôi làng bị cô lập vì lũ.

definition: soft white pieces of frozen water that fall from the sky
exampleSentence: Snow fell all night.
exampleTranslation: Tuyết rơi suốt đêm.

definition: with a lot of snow
exampleSentence: The snowy fields looked beautiful.
exampleTranslation: Những cánh đồng phủ tuyết trông thật đẹp.

definition: white powdery ice that covers things outside when it is very cold
exampleSentence: The grass was white with frost.
exampleTranslation: Cỏ trắng xóa vì sương giá.

definition: frozen raindrops that fall as hard balls of ice
exampleSentence: Hail broke the car window.
exampleTranslation: Mưa đá làm vỡ cửa kính xe.

definition: to become hard and solid because it is very cold
exampleSentence: The lake freezes every winter.
exampleTranslation: Hồ đóng băng vào mỗi mùa đông.

definition: to become liquid because of heat
exampleSentence: The snow began to melt.
exampleTranslation: Tuyết bắt đầu tan.

definition: to give out bright light
exampleSentence: The sun was shining.
exampleTranslation: Mặt trời đang chiếu sáng.

definition: a sudden shaking of the ground that can cause damage
exampleSentence: The earthquake shook the whole city.
exampleTranslation: Trận động đất làm rung chuyển cả thành phố.

definition: everything in the world not made by people, such as plants and animals
exampleSentence: I love walking in nature.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích đi dạo giữa thiên nhiên.

definition: the air, water and land where people, animals and plants live
exampleSentence: We must protect the environment.
exampleTranslation: Chúng ta phải bảo vệ môi trường.

definition: the natural beauty of a place, such as mountains and forests
exampleSentence: The scenery here is fantastic.
exampleTranslation: Phong cảnh ở đây thật tuyệt.

definition: land outside cities and towns
exampleSentence: We drove through the countryside.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi lái xe qua vùng nông thôn.

definition: animals and plants that live in natural conditions
translation: động vật hoang dã, thế giới hoang dã
exampleSentence: This park is full of wildlife.
exampleTranslation: Công viên này có rất nhiều động vật hoang dã.

definition: a tall plant with a trunk, branches and leaves
exampleSentence: The children climbed the tree.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ trèo lên cây.

definition: a part of a tree that grows out from the trunk
exampleSentence: A bird sat on the branch.
exampleTranslation: Một con chim đậu trên cành cây.

definition: the coloured part of a plant that appears before the fruit
exampleSentence: I picked some flowers in the garden.
exampleTranslation: Tôi hái vài bông hoa trong vườn.

definition: a common green plant with thin leaves that covers the ground
exampleSentence: The children sat on the grass.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ ngồi trên cỏ.

definition: a plant with many thin branches growing from the ground
exampleSentence: There is a rose bush in the garden.
exampleTranslation: Trong vườn có một bụi hoa hồng.

definition: a large area of land covered with trees
exampleSentence: We walked through the forest.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi bộ xuyên qua khu rừng.

definition: a thick tropical forest in a place where it rains a lot
translation: rừng nhiệt đới, rừng mưa nhiệt đới
exampleSentence: The rain forest is home to many animals.
exampleTranslation: Rừng nhiệt đới là nhà của nhiều loài động vật.

definition: a thick tropical forest with many plants growing close together
exampleSentence: They travelled through the jungle.
exampleTranslation: Họ đi xuyên qua rừng rậm.

definition: the hard material that trees are made of
exampleSentence: This table is made of wood.
exampleTranslation: Cái bàn này làm bằng gỗ.

definition: a long natural flow of water that goes into the sea
exampleSentence: We swam in the river.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi bơi ở sông.

definition: a small narrow river
exampleSentence: A small stream runs through the forest.
exampleTranslation: Một dòng suối nhỏ chảy qua khu rừng.

definition: a place where river water falls down over a rock or cliff
exampleSentence: We hiked to a beautiful waterfall.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi bộ đến một thác nước rất đẹp.

definition: a large area of water with land all around it
exampleSentence: You can swim in the lake.
exampleTranslation: Bạn có thể bơi ở hồ.

definition: a small area of water, smaller than a lake
exampleSentence: There are fish in the pond.
exampleTranslation: Có cá trong ao.

definition: the large area of salty water that covers much of the Earth
exampleSentence: The children ran into the sea.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ chạy xuống biển.

definition: one of the very large areas of sea on Earth
exampleSentence: The Pacific is the biggest ocean.
exampleTranslation: Thái Bình Dương là đại dương lớn nhất.

definition: a line of raised water that moves across the sea
exampleSentence: We watched the waves hit the rocks.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ngắm sóng đánh vào đá.

definition: an area of sand or small stones next to the sea
exampleSentence: We spent the day on the beach.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ở bãi biển cả ngày.

definition: the area where the land meets the sea
exampleSentence: They live on the east coast.
exampleTranslation: Họ sống ở bờ biển phía đông.

definition: a piece of land with water all around it
exampleSentence: We visited a small island.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi thăm một hòn đảo nhỏ.

definition: a very high hill
exampleSentence: We climbed the mountain.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi leo lên ngọn núi.

definition: an area of land higher than the land around it, but smaller than a mountain
exampleSentence: Their house is on a hill.
exampleTranslation: Nhà của họ nằm trên một ngọn đồi.

definition: low land between two lines of hills or mountains
exampleSentence: A river runs through the valley.
exampleTranslation: Một con sông chảy qua thung lũng.

definition: a high rock with a very steep side, often next to the sea
exampleSentence: Be careful near the edge of the cliff.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cẩn thận gần mép vách đá.

definition: a large natural hole in a cliff or under the ground
exampleSentence: Bats live in the cave.
exampleTranslation: Dơi sống trong hang.

definition: a mountain with a hole at the top where hot rock can come out
exampleSentence: The volcano erupted last year.
exampleTranslation: Núi lửa đã phun trào vào năm ngoái.

definition: a large mass of ice that moves slowly down a mountain valley
exampleSentence: The glacier is getting smaller every year.
exampleTranslation: Sông băng nhỏ đi mỗi năm.

definition: a large dry area with few plants and a lot of sand or rocks
exampleSentence: It is very hot in the desert.
exampleTranslation: Ở sa mạc rất nóng.

definition: an area of land in the country where crops or grass grow
exampleSentence: The cows are in the field.
exampleTranslation: Những con bò đang ở trên đồng.

definition: a narrow track for walking
exampleSentence: We followed the path through the woods.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi theo lối mòn qua rừng.

definition: the hard substance that forms the Earth, or a large piece of it
exampleSentence: I sat on a big rock.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ngồi trên một tảng đá lớn.

definition: tiny grains of rock that cover beaches and deserts
exampleSentence: The children played in the sand.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ chơi trên cát.

definition: wet earth that has become soft and sticky
exampleSentence: The kids were covered in mud.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ lấm lem bùn.

definition: the top layer of earth in which plants grow
exampleSentence: This soil is good for growing vegetables.
exampleTranslation: Loại đất này tốt cho việc trồng rau.

definition: dry powder made of very small bits of dirt
exampleSentence: The furniture was covered in dust.
exampleTranslation: Đồ đạc phủ đầy bụi.

definition: the space above the Earth where clouds and stars appear
exampleSentence: The sky is blue today.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay trời xanh.

definition: the large round object that shines in the sky at night
exampleSentence: The moon is bright tonight.
exampleTranslation: Tối nay trăng sáng.

definition: a ball of burning gas that you see as a point of light at night
exampleSentence: I looked up at the stars.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ngước nhìn những vì sao.

definition: a large round object in space that moves around the sun
exampleSentence: Mars is a planet.
exampleTranslation: Sao Hỏa là một hành tinh.

definition: the planet that we live on
exampleSentence: The Earth moves around the sun.
exampleTranslation: Trái Đất quay quanh mặt trời.

definition: the time in the morning when the sun first appears
translation: bình minh, lúc mặt trời mọc
exampleSentence: We got up at sunrise.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi dậy lúc mặt trời mọc.

definition: the time in the evening when the sun disappears
translation: hoàng hôn, lúc mặt trời lặn
exampleSentence: We watched the sunset from the beach.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ngắm hoàng hôn từ bãi biển.

definition: the mixture of gases around the Earth that we breathe
exampleSentence: Let us go outside and get some air.
exampleTranslation: Ra ngoài hít thở không khí đi.

definition: clean air from outside
exampleSentence: Open the window and let in some fresh air.
exampleTranslation: Mở cửa sổ cho không khí trong lành vào đi.

definition: flames, light and heat that burn and destroy things
exampleSentence: There was a big fire in the forest.
exampleTranslation: Có một đám cháy lớn trong rừng.

definition: dirty substances that harm the air, water or soil
exampleSentence: Pollution is a big problem in many cities.
exampleTranslation: Ô nhiễm là vấn đề lớn ở nhiều thành phố.

definition: waste paper, cans and other rubbish left on the ground in public places
exampleSentence: Please do not drop litter in the park.
exampleTranslation: Xin đừng xả rác trong công viên.

definition: to treat used things so they can be used again
exampleSentence: We recycle all our bottles and cans.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi tái chế tất cả chai và lon.
